name: Strange Hunting Grounds
detailed_description:
Game Description

《Strange Hunting Grounds》 is a survival roguelite action game set in a world inspired by the Inferno of Dante’s Divine Comedy. Players explore various circles of hell, each uniquely themed, battling monsters and bosses while developing their characters.

Key Features

Inferno-Inspired World
The game’s exploration mode recreates the circles of hell from Dante’s Inferno, including Acheron, Limbo, Lust, Gluttony, and Greed. Each area features distinct environments, unique monsters, and powerful bosses. Players rescue characters and collect items as they journey through this underworld.

Eight Unique Characters
There are eight playable characters, each with exclusive weapons and special abilities. Characters are unlocked and rescued through exploration, and collecting more characters increases passive abilities.

Deep Progression Systems

  • Core stat upgrades (Health, Defense, Recovery, Attack, etc.)

  • Weapon evolution and transcendence (17 out of 22 weapons can be evolved)

  • Rune equipment and upgrades (10 types, up to 5 equipped per character)

  • Gear enhancement (various grades, synthesis, and leveling)

Extensive Collection Content

  • 119 types of monsters (including 25 mid-bosses and 5 main bosses)

  • 72 items, all obtainable through gameplay

  • Weapons, music records, and more to collect

Game Modes

  • Hunting Mode: Endless maps for repeatable survival challenges

  • Exploration Mode: Traverse the circles of hell, rescue characters, and face bosses

  • Tutorial and regular stages, with additional exploration stages unlocked as you progress

Quest System
Over 154 quests and missions are available, offering diverse objectives and rewards.

Music Room
Enjoy 14 original soundtrack tracks. Some can be acquired in-game, while others may be purchased separately. The OST will also be sold separately on Steam.

All content in Strange Hunting Grounds is available through gameplay, with no microtransactions or advertisements.
